_comment: Build-phase static SA government bond end-of-day reference prices — business days from 2026-05-21 through 2026-06-01. Clean price is a percentage of par (e.g. 101.45 = 101.45% of nominal); yield is decimal (0.0802 = 8.02%). Used by the build-phase bond-price ingester (platform/market-data/bond-price-ingester.ts) to seed reference-price ticks into MarketDataStore for the market-data dashboard's Bonds section. These are REFERENCE prices for display; bond valuation/MTM continues to flow through OfficialMarkAdopted events.
_provenance: Build-phase fixture variant. Production JSE Debt Market price feed is sequenced post-licence. Ticks carry provenance=production in MarketDataStore (JSE Debt Market is an exchange-grade source) and fixingVariant=build-phase-fixture in payload.
_instruments: R186 (ZAG000030108, 10.5% due 2026-12-21) trades above par on its high coupon / short residual maturity (~7mo), yield ~8.0%. R2030 (ZAG000057547, 7.75% due 2030-01-31) below par, yield ~9.2%. R2040 (ZAG000074989, 9.0% due 2040-01-31) below par, yield ~10.5%.
